notes.title: CTCZ 2.0 Coming Soon
notes.content:
Howdy folks, big update coming to ctcz.  I am aiming for a release in April.  I plan to add: 
1. large extension of the game 
2. more customization in loading, title, death screens etc.  
3.  more clowns thugs and cops (duh)
4. And endgame 
5. Let me know in the comments

Also: I do not believe I can implement multiplayer even though I want to.  I am working on other projects as well, so if there are any "real" developers out there that wanna say f*ck it and help out let me know in the comments!

Peace!
